name: Falkner
beschreibung:
Quietly perched above Soelden with scenic views, Haus Falkner provides an ideal base for a refreshing holiday in the Oetztal. This warmly managed house features well-equipped apartments with private balconies overlooking the mountains.

The base stations of the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl cable cars are just minutes away, ensuring top alpine recreation in both summer and winter.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Falkner in Soelden offers cosy holiday apartments in a quiet panoramic location with quick access to mountain lifts.
